notes: Identity verified from supplied transcription: article title Measuring Global Oral Proficiency in SLA Research: A New Elicited Imitation Test of L2 Chinese; Shu-Ling Wu and Lourdes Ortega; Foreign Language Annals 46(4), 680–704, 2013; DOI 10.1111/flan.12063 on PDF page 1. Cache is a Scribd-hosted, page-labelled transcription of the primary article, including methods, results, discussion, references and appendices across 25 pages, rather than an abstract or secondary report. OCR/callback formatting retained in evidence. No source PDF was supplied; layout could not be independently rendered. Analytic N arithmetic: 20 + 20 + 20 + 20 = 80 from explicitly identified equal groups. Table 3 identifies low HLL, low FLL, high HLL, high FLL groups. Table 4 supplies the background main-effect values; requested etasq differs from the printed partial eta squared metric. Table footnote p < 0.01 and significance narrative do not agree with the Background row Sig. .011; retain the row value without correction. Other Table 4 effects are curricular level and interaction, not the target background main effect. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
